description.zh: 实例初始化时设置一个或多个环境变量。
description.en: Set one or more environment variables during instance initialization.

Refresh rate, in Hz. Valid values:

- 30

- 60

- 120
ID of the instance to upgrade or downgrade.
Target instance type for the AIC container.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ens modify-aic-instance-type --instance-id aic-xxxx-0 --instance-type aic.cf52r.c1.np --image-id yourImage_ID --environment-var object_Object --resolution 72001280 --frequency 30 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ens ModifyAICInstanceType --region cn-hangzhou --InstanceId 'aic-xxxx-0' --ImageId yourImage_ID --Frequency 30 --InstanceType 'aic.cf52r.c1.np' --EnvironmentVar object_Object --Resolution 72001280
